hypothesis.statement: On the same real occipital O1-Oz pair whose alpha PLV is 0.92 (near zero phase lag), the phase-lag index (PLI, which is ~0 for zero-lag coupling) is LOW -- the high PLV is dominated by volume conduction / common reference, not lagged neural coupling; phaseLagIndex reproduces an independent scipy Hilbert-band PLI and recovers ground truth with the contrast (constructed zero-lag -> PLI~0 while PLV~1; lagged -> PLI high; independent -> both ~0).

analysis_plan.dataset: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb, PhysioNet), subject S002 baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), occipital channels O1 and Oz, first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples each)

decision.threshold: descriptive: phaseLagIndex equals an independent scipy Hilbert-band PLI to < 1e-2 (agreement; PLI is more sign-sensitive near zero-lag than PLV), the sign formula is exact (< 1e-9), and it recovers the volume-conduction contrast (constructed zero-lag PLI < 0.1 while PLV > 0.9; lagged PLI > 0.9); the real O1-Oz alpha PLI is far below its PLV
